Them: Oh, I've actually been dealing with some foot pain lately, so I've been trying to find the best shoes for it. Have you tried any orthotics?

You: Interesting! I didn't know you had foot issues. I've heard orthotics can be really helpful. By the way, I was saying that because I've been considering learning how to dance. Have you ever taken any dance classes before?
